name: 話題の名前と件数を別々に編集するラベル
prompt: Render exactly ONE Japanese Lighthouse topic/count badge. The original neutral outlined rounded rectangle is primary for border anatomy: white fill, thin light-gray outline, rounded corners about one-quarter of badge height, NOT fully pill semicircles. Exact two separate text runs: topic '人の多さ' in dark #1D1D1D Meiryo REGULAR14/24 and count '67' in gray #6E6E6E Meiryo Regular12/16. Count is separate, do not append 件 or parenthesis. Both normal Regular strokes, zero tracking, never bold/semibold. Native Japanese mock guides wide badge proportions, about180x38 at design scale, left topic with12px inset, count separated by comfortable space in right half, same baseline, centered vertically. Match source thin neutral border and modest radius. White #FFFFFF surrounding canvas with tight small margin around the badge, no giant poster whitespace. No heading, icon, checkmark, green color, additional badges, shadows or explanatory text. Unselected informational badge only; not a button-state variant to invent. Preserve exact67 count and wording.
reviewNotes: Correct topic 人の多さ and separate gray67, Regular hierarchy, neutral unselected outline. Corner radius too square relative to original quarter-height radius; targeted outline-only radius correction needed, preserve text and state.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
